book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: U KAꞌBꞌ Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU CORINTO Ikaꞌv uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Corinto uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: As jit tzꞌajinal la untzꞌibꞌa bꞌen kaꞌtoj yol sete tiꞌ imolpu unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ tetz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesúseꞌ tu u Judea,

tan ootzimal svaꞌn uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ etaqꞌat u lochbꞌaleꞌ, jankꞌal ex uveꞌ echen ex tu u Acaya. As umaꞌx tzan yaabꞌeꞌ kat xeꞌt ex tiꞌ emolat u lochbꞌaleꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tukꞌ chit chiibꞌichil ni voksa eqꞌii vatz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tzitzaꞌ tu u Macedonia. As tul kat tabꞌi chajaak uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl nebꞌaneꞌ, as nimal chajaak kat ok veꞌt xeꞌ taama tiꞌ ilochon unpajte.

Estiꞌeꞌ nunchaj bꞌen unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ sexoꞌl, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la eesal iqꞌii unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat val setiꞌ te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tu unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan alel veꞌt te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ svaꞌn uvaꞌ bꞌanel veꞌt tuch unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ setaꞌn, tul uvaꞌ la oon chajaak sexoꞌl.

As yeꞌ nunsaꞌ uvaꞌ tul la oon veꞌt in tukꞌ unqꞌa aa Macedonia, as tul yeꞌl unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ molel setaꞌn. As chꞌixubꞌal veꞌt oꞌ vatz chajaak la ibꞌaneꞌ. As tul kꞌujleꞌl unkꞌuꞌl setiꞌ uvaꞌ maꞌt emolat u lochbꞌaleꞌ.

Estiꞌeꞌ kat vitzꞌa veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ techal chit la bꞌaxik bꞌen unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tiꞌ bꞌen iqꞌelut ex, as tiꞌ bꞌen talat sete tiꞌ itzojpisal imolpu unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ alel veꞌt setaꞌn. Tan asoj bꞌanel veꞌt tuch unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ setaꞌn tul la oon oꞌ, as aꞌ la ekꞌuchkateꞌ uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ etaqꞌataꞌ. As yeꞌ kat ebꞌan kaꞌl ekꞌuꞌl stiꞌ.
As tuk vulsa sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ abꞌil uvaꞌ bꞌiil kuxh iia la tava, as unbꞌiil kuxh ivatz la imoleꞌ. Pet abꞌil uvaꞌ nimal iia la tava, as nimal ivatz la imoleꞌ.

Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete uvaꞌ yeꞌ la kaꞌkabꞌin etaama tiꞌ etaqꞌat unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ. As jit yaꞌlumal ex stiꞌ. Pet junun ex la aqꞌon jankꞌoj uvaꞌ la chee tetaanxelal tiꞌ etaqꞌataꞌ, tan abꞌil uvaꞌ tukꞌ chit chiibꞌichil la taqꞌ u lochbꞌaleꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ nichiibꞌ u Tiixheꞌ stiꞌ.

As nim talcheꞌ u Tiixheꞌ. As yeꞌ la yaꞌ Aak tiꞌ taqꞌat vibꞌaꞌnileꞌ setiꞌ, kꞌuxh kam kuxh la epalebꞌe. As yeꞌ la yaꞌ ekꞌulat vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ, tan la chee veꞌt etetz, jankꞌal uvaꞌ la saꞌvit setiꞌ. As yeꞌ la yaꞌ veꞌt ex tiꞌ elochoneꞌ,
tan ech ni tal u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Abꞌil uvaꞌ ni niman u Tiixheꞌ, as niloch unqꞌa meebꞌaꞌeꞌ.
As yeꞌ nisotzsa Aak skꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u jikeꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ ni aqꞌon unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tavaleꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa echbꞌubꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ ni techbꞌuleꞌ, as Aakeꞌ la aqꞌon sete jankꞌal uvaꞌ la saꞌvit setiꞌ. As la inaꞌsa veꞌt Aak jankꞌal unqꞌa etetzeꞌ uvaꞌ ati, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la yaꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ tiꞌ elochoneꞌ.

As nimal bꞌaꞌnileꞌ la ibꞌan Aak setiꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl la eloch unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. As tul la bꞌen qaqꞌ u lochbꞌaleꞌ ste, as la taqꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl kat elocha.

As u lochbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ la etaqꞌeꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ bꞌaꞌn vatz u Tiixheꞌ. As jit kuxh tiꞌ ilochpu unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam nisaꞌvit stiꞌ. Pet nimal taꞌntiixh la taqꞌ veꞌt chajaak te u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ u lochbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ.

As tul uvaꞌ la ikꞌul unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u lochbꞌaleꞌ, as la toksa veꞌt chajaak iqꞌii u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ nenima u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo, as tiꞌ uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ elochat chajaak as tiꞌ elochat unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ skajayil.
As tul la inach veꞌt chajaak Tiixh setiꞌ, as ayaꞌl chit ikꞌuꞌl chajaak la isaꞌ tootzit veꞌt ex, tiꞌ tilat vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ uveꞌ aqꞌel veꞌt sete taꞌn Aak.
¡Estiꞌeꞌ qaqꞌtaj taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ vinimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ! As yeꞌl umaꞌtoj txumbꞌal ati uvaꞌ kam la qulbꞌe tiꞌ qaqꞌat taꞌntiixh te Aak tiꞌ u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan Aak sqe.
